basics.name: Prateek Tiwari
basics.label: Research Associate (Pre-Doctoral)
basics.summary: Research Associate (Pre-Doctoral) at the Indian School of Business (ISB), working at the intersection of technology and work. Builds large-scale data infrastructures and analytic tools to study how AI and digital platforms reshape jobs, skills, and organisational learning, using NLP, LLMs, and embedding-based methods.

location.address: AC 6, Level 1, Wing B, ISB Hyderabad

work.name: Indian School of Business (ISB)
work.summary: Works with Prof. Deepa Mani on projects examining how AI and digital platforms reshape jobs and skills. Developed large-scale labour market databases, skill ontologies, embedding-based alignment across taxonomies, and integrated survey and job-posting data for empirical analysis.
highlights: Built AI/ML pipelines for extracting and standardising job postings at national scale
Developed skill ontology integrating O*NET, NCO, NIC, and Lightcast
Conducted embedding-based validation and entity disambiguation
Contributed to scholarly and policy-oriented research outputs

work.name: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)
work.summary: Worked on large-scale digital transformation for a Middle East telecom client, applying ML and NLP techniques to CRM data and automating data workflows.
highlights: 44% reduction in time-to-market through workflow automation

publications.name: Bridging Skill (Data) Gaps: Methodology and Results for an Indian Software Skills Database
publications.summary: Presented methodological framework for constructing a national-scale skills database using job postings, LLM-based extraction, and taxonomy alignment.
